name: 1390 Mission Street
note: 1390 Mission Street on the corner of 10th (door 1398): eleven storeys of cream render whose Mission front bows out as a green-grey curtain wall, a tall red blade with a glazed slot beside it where the bow ends, a plain wing with punched windows stepping down at the front, and a grey-green concrete podium over a glass cafe. From the owner's Street View frame (2026-10-21) and Mapillary docs/shots/refs/1390-mission (09). Height: DataSF 2010 LiDAR median 37.3 m, max 42 m (OSM's 55 m is the block's bulk tag). Replaces the Haiku bauhaus restyle in reface-haiku.json, which took the red blade for the neighbour's. Builder: src/render/landmarks/sf/mission-tenth.ts.
